what: When neither --base nor --staged is set, gate suppressions scans every untracked non-ignored file from git ls-files --others --exclude-standard as wholly added lines. --staged stays the index. --base stays base...HEAD. Gitignored paths are not scanned. docs/guide/Gates.md and the CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed entry describe the selection.
done_criteria: pytest reports an untracked non-ignored file that contains a suppression marker
pytest does not report a gitignored file that contains a suppression marker
pytest shows --base and --staged still ignore untracked files
docs/guide/Gates.md states that the default scan includes untracked non-ignored files
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased contains a Fixed entry for the suppressions scan of untracked files
